narrative.details:
Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, adventurer.  He knows the orcish language better than most.  And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!

The captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Spy's Report to Captain Garran Vimes.
narrative.offerRewardText: A report from an orc spy! How did you find this? No matter -- let's see what it says...
